recommendations.title: GitHub OIDC role grants eks:* and ec2:* on every resource
recommendations.summary: The aws_iam_policy attached to the GitHub Actions OIDC role allows eks:* and ec2:* with Resource set to "*", so any workflow assuming this role can make any EKS or EC2 API call against every resource in the account.
recommendations.impact: A compromised or malicious workflow could delete clusters, alter node groups, or launch instances anywhere in the account, and the audit trail would not distinguish that from a normal deploy.
recommendations.suggested_change: Replace eks:* and ec2:* with the specific API calls the deploy job actually makes, and constrain Resource to the cluster and node group ARNs this pipeline manages.
recommendations.trade_offs: Enumerating the exact call set takes iteration against a real deploy, and a missed permission fails the pipeline until it is added.
recommendations.confidence_explanation: The wildcard actions and Resource "*" are read directly from the parsed policy statement.
